subject.title: feat(gateway): watched sessions in presence with viewer facepiles

question: Should watched-session identifiers be emitted only to recipients authorized to read those sessions, with the field omitted from pairing-only and node-role presence projections?
rationale: The feature intentionally exposes collaboration metadata, but the current shared presence broadcast crosses a broader recipient boundary than session discovery; maintainers must confirm the permanent disclosure contract before implementation can be accepted.

options.title: Add read-scoped presence projection
options.body: Emit `watchedSessions` only to recipients authorized for session read access and omit it from the broader presence projection.

options.title: Keep global presence metadata
options.body: Intentionally allow all current presence recipients to observe watched-session identifiers and document that expanded disclosure boundary.

options.title: Defer watched-session presence
options.body: Land identity-only presence work and revisit viewer indicators after a dedicated access-controlled presence contract exists.

recommendation.title: Add read-scoped presence projection
recommendation.body: Emit `watchedSessions` only to recipients authorized for session read access and omit it from the broader presence projection.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged identity-presence predecessor and the proposed watched-session extension.
